offering_description.value: Develops and sells orthobiologic products (bone grafts, biomaterials) and spinal implant and fixation hardware to hospitals and surgeons. Products are made in-house, including tissue processing, and sold mainly in the US through distributors and direct reps.

primary_products.value: bone graft substitutes; allograft tissue products; spinal implants; spinal fixation hardware; biomaterials

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, surgery centers, spine and orthopedic surgeons, and OEM partners

end_markets.value: spine surgery; orthopedic surgery; neurosurgery; biologics

revenue_model.value: product sales: orthobiologics, spinal implants and instruments sold to hospitals, OEM manufacturing supply

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: processes donated tissue and manufactures implants and biomaterials, sold to hospitals and surgeons; brand owner: markets branded spine and biologic product lines to surgeons

geography_served.value: global: Primarily United States, with some international sales through distributors

specialization.value: related lines: orthobiologics and spinal implants sold to the same surgeons and hospitals

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent commissioned distributors and sales agencies; direct sales: direct sales reps and OEM customers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical devices and human tissue products regulated by FDA (510(k), HCT/P rules) and state tissue regulations

P2.3: Headquartered in Montana, Xtant Medical combines the rigor of science with the heart of purpose. We started as a spin-off from Montana State University’s Center for Biofilm Engineering. We evolved into Xtant Medical, where today, we deliver a comprehensive biologics and fixation portfolio while staying true to our roots: honoring donors, serving patients, and innovating for the future. Our biologics are processed in a dedicated, state-of-the-art facility using patented technologies like BacteRinse™ to preserve essential growth factors while ensuring safety and clinical reliability. This focus allows us to honor every donor gift with the highest standards of quality and respect.
